Companion Animal Travel Desk Standards

This section sets out the conduct, care, and handover rules that protect animals and support smooth service at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must treat every carrier as occupied unless confirmed otherwise, keep movement steady, and speak in calm, clear language when interacting with travelers and the ground team.

At the desk, all records must be checked before any animal is accepted for onward movement. Labels, owner details, and service notes must be complete, legible, and attached in a way that will not detach during handling. If an animal appears unsettled, staff should reduce noise, limit unnecessary handling, and notify the senior coordinator at once. Travelers such as Emil Lee and Rafael Adeyemi should receive courteous guidance, but staff must never promise an exception that has not been approved.

Care at the Companion Animal Travel Desk also includes careful transfer between services. Carriers must remain upright unless veterinary instructions state otherwise, and staff must use both hands when lifting where the carrier design requires it. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and desk staff must verify that each handover is matched to the correct document set before release. Poppy, like any other pet, must not be left unattended in a public area or near open service paths.

When a lounge or waiting area is involved, staff must follow local instructions without deviation and keep pet welfare ahead of convenience. Any sign of distress, injury, leakage, escape risk, or refusal of intake must be reported immediately so that the right support can be arranged. No one should improvise a remedy when a standard procedure is available.

If there is uncertainty about acceptance, welfare, paperwork, or transfer control, contact the senior coordinator or the duty manager for immediate guidance.
